ImageDescription.value: YOKOSUKA, Japan (Dec. 2, 2025) – Fireman Hull Technician Ethan Throwbridge helps Damage Controlman 2nd Class Kentorian Hilson dress out for a damage control drill aboard U.S. 7th Fleet flagship USS Blue Ridge (LCC 19), while in Yokosuka, Japan, Dec. 2. 2025. Blue Ridge and embarked U.S. 7th Fleet staff conduct regular Indo-Pacific patrols to deter aggression, strengthen alliances and partnerships, and advance future warfighting capabilities. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Zachary Del Rio)
